events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Album Milestone
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, experimental masterpiece, the 'White Album'. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost a true icon. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and showmanship continue to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Classic Album
angles.copy: The sound of 1965. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped on this day, pushing musical boundaries and cementing their legend. Still sounds fresh!

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years on, his message of peace still resonates. Remembering the visionary John Lennon, a timeless musical and cultural force.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic 'Starman' David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering Bowie
angles.copy: Forever the chameleon of rock. David Bowie would have been 80 today, leaving behind an unparalleled legacy of music and style.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Hail to the King
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have turned 92 today, his music and legend still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro of the fretboard, Jimmy Page! From Yardbirds to Zeppelin, a true guitar god.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Still rockin' at 82! Happy birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart, whose incredible career spans decades of hits.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy Birthday
angles.copy: Our House, in the middle of our street... and it's Suggs' 66th birthday! Happy returns to the inimitable frontman of Madness.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Smooth Operator
angles.copy: Wherever he lays his hat, that's his home, and today it's his 71st birthday! Happy birthday to the fantastic Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The beloved country music icon Dolly Parton would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering Dolly
angles.copy: Jolene, Jolene, Jolene... and a very happy would-be 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton. Her legacy shines on.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Rule the world! Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow. Still writing the hits!

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: When the going gets tough, the tough get going... to wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday! What's your favourite hit?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Music History
angles.copy: 38 years ago, rock royalty gathered for the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who was your favourite from that legendary first class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming audiences after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 58 years since The Beatles performed their legendary impromptu rooftop concert in London in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Gig
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles went up on the roof! That legendary rooftop concert in 1969 - a truly iconic moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The acclaimed singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Music Legend
angles.copy: In the air tonight... it's Phil Collins' 76th birthday! Wishing a very happy day to the Genesis icon and solo superstar.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack for 46 years! Happy birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure and beloved actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Only Fools & Horses Legend
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only Sir David Jason. A true British acting icon.

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Music History
angles.copy: 68 years since we lost three legends. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'. Forever in our playlists.
